title: install-local admits a manifest.namespace that ManifestSchema refuses ('' , 'QA_N', '9-Bad Ns!') — the door parses id and installModes through the declaration but never namespace
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzj9DrVWXkq7joYHGB

Kind: product defect (off-clause probe finding, observed beside platform-core.namespace-co-owner-name-refusal)

## Reproduction (objectstack b914e7247f69, 18.5.0)

Stock showcase scratch copy booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin --no-watch -p 41206` (own OS_HOME, own file DB), seeded admin bearer token.

1. `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` with
   `{"manifest":{"id":"com.qa.p-up","name":"p","version":"1.0.0","type":"app","namespace":"QA_N","pages":[{"name":"qa_board","label":"x","type":"app","regions":[]}]}}`
   → **200** `success: true` (hotLoaded). The same with `"namespace":""` (id com.qa.p-empty) → 200, and with
   `"namespace":"9-Bad Ns!"` (id com.qa.p-bad2) → 200.
2. `GET /api/v1/packages` lists com.qa.p-up with namespace `'QA_N'`, com.qa.p-empty with `''`, com.qa.p-bad2 with
   `'9-Bad Ns!'`, source `marketplace`; `GET /api/v1/meta/page` serves qa_board for each of them.
3. Reproduced twice on the same boot with three different ids. In the same boot com.qa.n-one already owned
   namespace `qa_n`; `QA_N` installed beside it without the ADR-0048 namespace gate answering.

Expected: 400 `PLUGIN_MANIFEST_INVALID` with the declaration's sentence, as the door already answers for a bad id
(`manifest` without `id` → 400 PLUGIN_MANIFEST_INVALID "Invalid package id ''…", same boot). The declaration:
`packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.zod.ts:565-569` — `namespace: z.string().regex(NAMESPACE_PATTERN, 'Namespace must be
2-20 chars, start with a lowercase letter, and contain only lowercase letters, digits and underscores')`, with
`NAMESPACE_PATTERN = /^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,19}$/` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/address-grammar.ts:36`).

## Mechanism

`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:2480-2490` parses only `manifest.id` through
`ManifestSchema.shape.id`, and `:4619` parses `installModes` through `ManifestSchema.shape.installModes`; no leg parses
`manifest.namespace` through `ManifestSchema.shape.namespace` (grep of the file for NAMESPACE_PATTERN /
`shape.namespace`: none), so an inline manifest written by hand (not by `objectstack build`, whose defineStack refuses
it) registers whatever string it carries. The namespace is the object-name prefix, the table-name prefix and the key the
install-time namespace gate compares, so a case-variant (`QA_N` beside `qa_n`) or empty namespace sidesteps the gate's
uniqueness reading.

Severity guess: P2 (admin-only door; malformed namespace enters the registry and the installed ledger).

## Duplicates searched

`gh api -X GET search/issues -f q='repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open …'` with:
- `install-local namespace pattern` → 5 hits, none about this (#23181 test budget, PM seat cards)
- `install-local namespace validation` → 6 hits, none about this (#33761 sweep anchor, #23181, PM seats)
- `namespace uppercase install` → 0
- `manifest namespace not validated` → 4 hits, none about this (#30349, PM seats)
- `NAMESPACE_PATTERN install` → 0
